items.name: Exterior lights row (BCN, LAND, TAXI, NAV, STRB)
Fuel selector (◀ FUEL, state, FUEL ▶)
items.notes: From the C172. Values 0 LEFT, 1 BOTH, 2 RIGHT.

items.name: Magneto set (◀ MAG, state, MAG ▶, START)
items.notes: From the C172. Steps OFF/R/L/BOTH and stops at BOTH; START is held to crank and re-sent every 250 ms. Values 0 OFF, 1 R, 2 L, 3 BOTH, 4 START: check the aircraft uses the same.

items.name: COM1 switch (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads COM RECEIVE:1 (bool); holds 1, releases to 0.

items.name: COM1 readout (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads COM ACTIVE FREQUENCY:1 (MHz); sends COM_STBY_RADIO_SWAP.

items.name: COM1 STBY (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:1 (MHz); sets undefined.

items.name: NAV1 (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads NAV ACTIVE FREQUENCY:1 (MHz); sends NAV1_RADIO_SWAP.

items.name: NAV1 STBY (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads NAV STANDBY FREQUENCY:1 (MHz); sets undefined.

items.name: COM2 switch (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads COM RECEIVE:2 (bool); holds 1, releases to 0.

items.name: COM2 readout (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads COM ACTIVE FREQUENCY:2 (MHz); sends COM2_RADIO_SWAP.

items.name: COM2 STBY (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:2 (MHz); sets undefined.

items.name: NAV2 (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads NAV ACTIVE FREQUENCY:2 (MHz); sends NAV2_RADIO_SWAP.

items.name: NAV2 STBY (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads NAV STANDBY FREQUENCY:2 (MHz); sets undefined.

items.name: QNH (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads KOHLSMAN SETTING MB:1 (millibars); sends BAROMETRIC.

items.name: TIME (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads LOCAL TIME (seconds); no press action.

items.name: PITOT HEAT (C172 G1000)
items.notes: Reads PITOT HEAT SWITCH (bool); sends PITOT_HEAT_TOGGLE.

items.name: BAT (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads ELECTRICAL MASTER BATTERY (bool); sends TOGGLE_MASTER_BATTERY.

items.name: ALT (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads GENERAL ENG MASTER ALTERNATOR:1 (bool); sends TOGGLE_MASTER_ALTERNATOR.

items.name: AVIONICS (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads AVIONICS MASTER SWITCH (bool); sends AVIONICS_MASTER_SET.

items.name: PITOT HEAT (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads PITOT HEAT SWITCH (bool); sends PITOT_HEAT_TOGGLE.

items.name: COM1 (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads COM ACTIVE FREQUENCY:1 (MHz); no press action.

items.name: COM1 STBY (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:1 (MHz); no press action.

items.name: QNH (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads KOHLSMAN SETTING MB:1 (millibars); no press action.

items.name: XPDR (any aircraft, classic simvars)
items.notes: Reads TRANSPONDER CODE:1 (number); no press action.

items.name: Stopwatch (time, start/stop, reset)
items.notes: A dock stopwatch named T1, counting sim time; kept across restarts. Rename T1 on all three keys for a second one.

items.name: Stopwatch on one key (tap start/stop, hold reset)
items.notes: Shows dock stopwatch T1; a tap starts or stops it, holding for 1 s resets it. The bar is green while it runs.

items.name: XPDR code, keypad entry (any aircraft)
items.notes: Shows TRANSPONDER CODE:1; pressing it opens a keypad to type a new value.

items.name: COM1 standby, keypad entry (any aircraft)
items.notes: Shows COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:1; pressing it opens a keypad to type a new value.

items.name: COM2 standby, keypad entry (any aircraft)
items.notes: Shows COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:2; pressing it opens a keypad to type a new value.

items.name: NAV1 standby, keypad entry (any aircraft)
items.notes: Shows NAV STANDBY FREQUENCY:1; pressing it opens a keypad to type a new value.

items.name: NAV2 standby, keypad entry (any aircraft)
items.notes: Shows NAV STANDBY FREQUENCY:2; pressing it opens a keypad to type a new value.
